decisions.reason: This dismantling joint is very close to the firm's core know-how in pipeline components, welding, coatings and utility applications, so absorptive capacity is high and the firm is likely to improve rather than withdraw it.

The ceiling or floor pipe bracket still fits the firm's metal fabrication and project-based customer base, but it is a somewhat more peripheral extension than core pipeline fittings, so the risk of discontinuation is modest rather than minimal.

The pipe support bracket draws on the firm's existing fabrication, welding and custom-solution capabilities for infrastructure projects, giving it enough relatedness and learning potential to justify keeping it on the market.
